items.title: Show HN: Understanding FAT16 - an interactive filesystem explainer (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: I made this explorable explanation of the FAT16 filesystem. This was largely to satisfy my own childhood curiosity about the defrag screen, but I thought others might appreciate it too. It's very text heavy but there are a number of interactive pieces that let you make changes, read files, and see the underlying bytes. The first one is in section 2. There's also a minigame at the end where you can defragment a disk by hand. Would love to hear corrections, feedback, or just historical color. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50678938 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
